what_is_closed: the corresponding-author request route is specified as a bounded, auditable acquisition package
each requested payload has a declared role, required units, provenance fields, and minimum acceptance test
the request distinguishes Ding source data from an independent reproduction and does not request or consume the Xie 2026 holdout
the request does not ask for or infer a fitted alpha_Phi_K value
major_result.equation_or_mapping: C_src(T) = sum_mu c_mu(T); Delta_Tq = Delta_u_ph / C_src; Phi_E = Delta_u_ph/e0

units.c_mu: J m^-3 K^-1 per mode or declared equivalent
units.e0: J m^-3 if supplied as a declared UET-independent energy scale

major_result.derivation_class: source-acquisition specification; no physical result or calibration emitted
major_result.observable: Ding PBTE temperature-response input provenance and reproducibility readiness
open_blockers: C_src_uncertainty_or_convergence_contract_not available from current Ding OA package
major_result.dependency_unlocked: source-acquisition readiness only; no numeric C_src, alpha_Phi_K, Full Topic 13, or downstream Core unlock
major_result.claim_boundary: This result makes the author-request route reproducible and bounded. It does not claim that the request was sent, that authors responded, that the requested data exist, or that Topic 13 is closed.

source_identity.title: Observation of Second Sound in Graphite over 200 K
source_identity.data_availability_locator: PMC full text, Data availability paragraph
source_identity.reported_route: supporting data available from the corresponding author on reasonable request

request_scope.purpose: reproduce the published Ding PBTE temperature-response input without using normalized TTG target residuals
material_state_geometry: natural graphite sample identity and isotope composition used for the published calculation
relaxed lattice vectors and atomic coordinates, with unit-cell volume and volume provenance
TTG temperature grid, grating periods, and boundary/scattering assumptions used by the published simulation
first_principles_inputs: VASP version and exact PAW dataset identifiers
exchange-correlation and vdW settings, plane-wave cutoff, convergence thresholds, and relaxed-structure inputs
second-order force constants or Phonopy FORCE_SETS/FORCE_CONSTANTS
third-order force constants or thirdorder.py outputs
ShengBTE CONTROL/input files, scattering settings, isotope and boundary assumptions, and 16 x 16 x 8 mesh outputs
numeric_mode_outputs: mode-resolved frequencies, eigenvectors, group velocities, and mode heat capacities c_mu(T)
the mode index convention and Brillouin-zone weights used in the sum
numeric C_src(T) = sum_mu c_mu(T) on the requested temperature grid
numerical precision, mesh or supercell convergence results, and uncertainty or sensitivity envelope
response_outputs: machine-readable PBTE response inputs/outputs needed to regenerate Delta_Tq(t) for the published TTG geometry
a data dictionary for every field and a statement of any post-processing or smoothing
a checksum for each delivered file and permission/terms for research reuse
cross_paper_reproduction_route: If the 2022 payload is unavailable, request the 2017/2019 graphite force-constant and full-scattering inputs used for the independent TTG PBTE reproduction.
Keep the 2019 HOPG specimen state separate from the 2022 natural-graphite specimen until morphology, isotope/defect state, temperature, and response-contract mapping are explicitly accepted.
Do not treat setup estimates or normalized traces as numeric C_src rows or as a base-Phi calibration.

acceptance_tests: delivered files open with a deterministic reader
all rows have stable identity and declared units
C_src(T) recomputes from the delivered c_mu(T) rows using the declared weights
unit-cell volume and source geometry match the declared material state
reported uncertainty or convergence can be recomputed from delivered runs or comparison meshes
all file hashes and permission terms are recorded
no calibration path reads Xie 2026 or any target residual
numeric alpha_Phi_K is not emitted unless a separate independent base-Phi amplitude record also passes its own acceptance contract
claim_boundary: The manifest is a request specification and provenance controller only. It contains no Ding numeric C_src rows, no independent base-Phi amplitude, no e0, no alpha_Phi_K, no prediction, and no external validation.

request_payload: machine-readable raw TTG time series and row identity
mode-resolved c_mu(T), aggregate C_src(T), and weights
full scattering matrix or reproducible W_ij construction inputs
second- and third-order graphite force constants used by the PBTE run
mesh, smearing, convergence, and source-grade uncertainty
permission terms and hashes for every delivered file
huberman_2019_graphite_ttg.acceptance_boundary: Formula/setup context only until the existing Ding-compatible C_src and source-record contracts pass.

request_payload: raw second- and third-order force constants
mode table and numerical convergence envelope
ding_2017_force_constant_route.acceptance_boundary: The public supplementary PDF is method context only; no C_src or force-constant payload is admitted from it.

request_payload: identify a specific graphite record and deliver stable row identity
mode-resolved c_mu(T), aggregate C_src(T), unit-cell volume, material state, and convergence
TTG response inputs or a permitted full-scattering reproduction
source-grade uncertainty, preprocessing, permission terms, and hashes
public_phonon_route_screening.acceptance_boundary: The screened routes remain metadata, formula, or solver context until the existing Ding-compatible C_src and source-record contracts pass.
